description: This is a PHP class file defining the TaxRate controller within the Opencart e-commerce platform. It manages tasks related to tax rates, such as generating task lists, retrieving tax rate info, saving JSON files, and clearing files.

classes.name: TaxRate
classes.description: Controller class for managing tax rate-related tasks in the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Generates a list of tasks for each geo zone to manage tax rates.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Retrieves and saves detailed tax rate data as a JSON file for a specific geo zone.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Deletes generated tax rate JSON files from the server.
